term: one actual concrete necessary ancestor without a rootness claim
definition: One member of the selected complete actual-concrete grounding cone exists at every world accessible from the selected actual world. The same witness is actual, concrete and an ancestor; it may have incoming actual concrete support. No rootness, all-world underivedness, unity or God identification is asserted.
note: Reuse of the existing Profile, complete cone, positive existence-fact constructor and Founded relation, not a new ontology or source reading. This is a representation of already selected grounds, not an automatic philosophical fact-to-concrete bridge. See the contingent-only foundation section of docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md.
